name: precision-async
why: calling what an async function returns calls a Promise, which throws before eval or fetch runs, so eval is no longer confirmed (v6 confirmed it and scored 80). The string's `fetch(` still counts as v3 counted it: `get` is a script's top-level binding, which another script could replace before the call

name: tag-eval
why: eval used as a tag is handed an array of the template's strings and returns it unrun. At a script's top level that array is the script's completion value, which code running the file through vm or eval receives, so v3's verdict stands; inside a function the same line proves harmless (see sol-parser-v6.test.ts)
